items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: Yeah, I knew him very well.

ctx.x: He was mostly in the Excelsior band. Do you remember the leader or anybody, the main ones in the brass band? Wooden Joe was in the band.

He worked? He worked in the band too. If he'd have been living, he was a great trumpet player. Yeah, I knew him very well. I'd be strong. You know? He was about the most powerful man in town. That's right.
